### Actual behaviour
i_CTRL-X_CTRL-N is breaks neovim with `classzsh: segmentation fault  nvim -u /tmp/init.vim --noplugin a.rb`:

![infercase](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/120483/24748395/776c4f12-1ab7-11e7-84a3-64d42c0ec1fc.gif)

### Expected behaviour
Work properly, like vim.

### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`

```
nvim -u NORC
:set ignorecase infercase
- with some text in the current buffer
i_CTRL-X_CTRL-N
```
